<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>Detects the specific 4-bit binary sequence 1001.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal to synchronize the detector.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">Active-low reset signal to initialize the state machine.</input>
        <input id="data_in">1-bit binary input signal to feed the bitstream for sequence detection.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">1-bit output signal that is set high when the specific sequence is detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>IDLE</parameter>
        <parameter>S1</parameter>
        <parameter>S2</parameter>
        <parameter>S3</parameter>
        <parameter>S4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state">4'b0000</reg>
        <wire id="next_state">4'b0000</wire>
        <wire id="match">1'b0</wire>

        <always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n)>
            if (!reset_n)
                current_state <= 4'b0000;
            else
                current_state <= next_state;
        end

        <assign match = (current_state == 4'b1001) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;

        <always @(*)>
            case (current_state)
                4'b0000: // IDLE
                    begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1)
                            next_state = 4'b0001;
                        else
                            next_state = 4'b0000;
                    end
                4'b0001: // S1
                    begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b0)
                            next_state = 4'b0010;
                        else
                            next_state = 4'b0000;
                    end
                4'b0010: // S2
                    begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b0)
                            next_state = 4'b0011;
                        else
                            next_state = 4'b0000;
                    end
                4'b0011: // S3
                    begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1)
                            next_state = 4'b0100;
                        else
                            next_state = 4'b0000;
                    end
                4'b0100: // S4
                    begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1)
                            next_state = 4'b0000;
                        else
                            next_state = 4'b0000;
                    end
                default:
                    next_state = 4'b0000;
            endcase
        end

        <assign sequence_detected = match;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>The sequence detector uses a finite state machine (FSM) to detect the specific 4-bit binary sequence 1001. It transitions through states based on the bitstream data_in. Once the complete sequence is detected, sequence_detected is asserted. The FSM resets to the IDLE state upon active-low reset.</implementation>
</module>
